name: AWS DynamoDB Patterns
summary: Design, implement, refactor, back up, restore, audit and load-test-plan Amazon DynamoDB access patterns in any language: keys and indexes, runtime contract, IAM and resource policies, encryption, PITR and on-demand recovery, Streams and DAX, native vector indexes and Bedrock/S3 embeddings, monitoring and CloudFormation/CLI provisioning, with command routes that load one guide at a time.
security_notes: Not permission to access AWS. Live reads need a confirmed account, role, Region and table; writes, deployment, backfill, deletion, restore and load tests need exact approval. Restores target a new table only. Never inspect credentials or print customer items. Bundled scripts are offline route selectors and a date-argument review reminder; example shell and SDK assets run only after explicit user approval.
